reviews.text: They say this is the world's largest glass bridge! It's remarkable and amazing! If you have the guts, do the bungee jump :) The Zipline across is so cool! If you are with little kids, you can take a slide down the mountain to the Canyon. It's so fun. Walking the glass bridge can go by quick so take your time. There's no need to rush!!

I had a beautiful experience at the Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge in China. It was great to conquer my little fear of heights as I walked across the stunning glass panels suspended high above the Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon. The walk was both fun and quite immersive, with breathtaking views of the misty peaks and lush greenery surrounding me, making it an unforgettable adventure. The thick, reinforced glass made me feel safe while still allowing me to fully enjoy the thrill and the surreal scenery below. It was exhilarating to push through the fear and embrace the adventure in such a unique and well-designed setting. This experience at the glass bridge in Zhangjiajie is truly one of the most memorable moments I had during my trip to China.

A most amazing feat of engineering, and also a spectacular view. It is also the world's highest bungee jumping base. Expect it to be extremely crowded... there are plenty of tourists clamouring to take photos in the middle. You need to put on special shoe covers to access the bridge.

Amazing place to visit! 100% recommend. The views from the bridge are amazing, even for those scared of heights looking through the glass onto trees was okay. The bridge has sections of metal so you do not need to walk on the class if you don't want to. They give you special shoe coverings to wear on the bridge. We also did a VR hot air balloon activity over the canyon, ziplined to the other side of the canyon (terrifying for thode scared of heights, but my friends loved it), took a slide down to the bottom of the canyon and then a short boat ride to the start of the hike. We hiked 3km along the canyon. If ziplining and a slide isn't your thing you can get an elevator down instead. To note: Zipline waiting time can be very long. There are toilets along the canyon walk. Take a waterproof coat or umbrella as some parts of the hike you walk under dripping rock.

Loved the view from this beautiful and long glass bridge. A popular spot for doing bungee and zip line too. Only one caveat, the glass on the bridge is quite badly scratched so the view underneath isn’t that great. The view of the canyon is simply mind blowing.

Bridge was very stable and fun. Glass was slightly murky and blurry, but still able to see below the bridge. Visibility can be bad during certain times/seasons, morning is less foggy than afternoon (End Dec 2025).

I think I had very high expectations from all the videos that I had watched. But it was still good. The glass wasn't as clear as I had expected but we had a fun time taking silly photos of one another and as a group. They give you shoe covers to put over your shoes to keep the glass clean before you walk on the glass. There's a food court at the other end of the bridge and toilets. The VR, slides and zip lining activities are at the other side of the bridge.

It was drizzling when we visited, placed is open 8am to 4pm. You need to put on rubber protective soles before you can walk on the glass bridge. This is the longest glass bridge in the world . It was pretty breathtaking walking on the glass bridge . You can also walk via Ferrata and feel like a cliff hangar . We did the extended reality /VR to ride on a hot air balloon to view ZhangJiaJie .

Take wonderful pictures from the glass bridge. Can try bungee jump for those who dare. Took the ski chair. It was exciting. Was worried initially but it was safe. Enjoy the view. Had some fun on the huge too. Be prepared to walk and climb many many steps. Be sure to arrive early to beat the crowd.

I love the Zipline. So fun and a great memorable experience. It is not scary at all as it is very slow and secure. We waited almost an hour on a Fri, for a one minute zipline ride. After that was a super long slide all the way down, round and round. You need to bend you body forward, don't hold your hands at the sides too tight, and position your legs so there is least friction and then you can slide easily.

Too many steps and toilet limited and quite difficult to find them. Long queues as many local travellers despite this being a off peak season. Glass floor can get dirty easily so don't try to lie on it for photo taking unless you don't mind.

Amazing experience. Unfortunately it was a foggy day but still magnificent. Even the bottom of the canion was foggy, you would feel the fear of waking over the glass in a really scary hight. Enjoyed it very much.

The glass bridge and the views were another highlight of Zhangjiajie. You are given shoe covers to wear over your shoes so you do not scratch the glass. Looking down through the glass can be a bit scary but looking straight ahead is absolutely fine. Views are incredible. There is an option to do a flying fox from one side to the other, then sliding down a slide. At the bottom you can also do a short cruise. A highlight of the area. A must see if not scared of heights.

I joined a travel agency trip in October 2025 to visit Zhangjiajie’s glass bridge. It was a simple glass bridge, and all visitors were required to wear the non-grip shoe covers provided. This is to prevent scratching the glass floor. Due to the huge crowd, it was difficult to fully appreciate the view because you could hardly look straight down through the glass. More importantly, travellers should have strong legs, as many public and restaurant toilets in China are squatting toilets. Some were extremely smelly, with a strong urine odour. Also, do bring your own toilet paper, as it is usually not provided.
Was there in December, low season, so plenty of opportunities to take photo and enjoy the view. An impressive piece of engineering. Would recommend this place.
Not scary, not esciting.. but the canyon around it and zipline are cool. I would skip the bridge and just go for surroundings

There’s quite a few things going on here, from the glass bridge you can go for their VR experience, then move on to the zip line, from there go down 2 slide sections and finally go for a boat ride! From the boat ride, you’ll need to walk and take 2-3 different elevators back to the glass bridge level and walk back to the entrance.
It’s an interesting & fabulous experience walking on the glass bridge. The views are awesome, gorgeous!
Wonderful place, went there in the off peak season, which is the winter season, beautiful scenery, fun activities, boat rides, most importantly the air is so fresh, really boost up our mood!
Must visit when in the area. While you're at it, also visit the Grand Canyon. It's enough for a full day of walking and sightseeing.

For a thrilling experience, you should walk across this glass bridge which also happens to be the world's longest glass bridge. It spans across zhangjiajie's grand canyon. Aside from this, you can also take the zip line across the canyon as well as walk along a narrow walkway on the cliff sides itself.

I loved this place. The nature view and the architecture of it , truly breathtaking and amazing. 🤩 kudos to the engineers. Loved all the activities here . So cool There was bungy jump as well .. I was so excited to do but , it cost nearly Malaysia 🇲🇾 money rm2000 ( hopefully 🤞🏽 next time in 🇲🇴 ) Please try the vr, zip line , the slide , boat 🚤 cruise… all was very exciting. I went during low peak season ( early January) very less crowd and it was peace ✌🏾. But it was so freezing 🥶 cold . How lucky 🍀 we was , it was raining ☔️ the day we visited - so please bring your raincoat and umbrella 🌂.

Before we enter the Grand Canyon Glass Bridge, we need put on their shoe covers not to damage their bridge. When walking, this transparent bridge seems to be suspended in the air, with bottomless streams and rugged rock formations under our feet. Although the glass was not clear, a bit worn out look by constant foot traffic, we could still see all the way down to the bottom of the canyons. There are handrails with metal structure showing signs of rust, along the walkway to ensure safety. It was very crowded with visitors, everyone is posing for photographs within the natural wonders and stunning beauty of the surrounding area. Half way through , there is a stairs down to a lower level where bungee jumping takes place. At the end of this bridge, lots of walk through the stairs to get to their toilets. There are numerous activities available, bungee jumping, a zip line between mountains and rock climbing. We joined the Balloon Trip with 4D VR experience. It simulate the high-attitude perspective of flying over the Grand Canyon through immersive images to feel the magnificient scenery of Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon !!!! It is amazing , wonderful and an unforgettable ride !!! Totally immersive and realistic!!!!
Nerve-wrecking for those who are afraid of height, certainly not recommended. Beautiful overview of the valley below, zip-line and the vertical elevator.

It looked a fascinating structure across the gorge but looked smaller than what was seen in the photos and videos. Also the glass was not clear, a bit worn out look by constant foot traffic, and the metal structure was showing signs of rust. Definitely needs a coat of paint and the glass floor needs replacing.
Superb! Must try! The zipline was tempting but the weather was too cold. Will go for it on next visit.
A site NOT TO MISS. Be totally captivated by the sight of China Grand Canyon! No picturesor postcard can capture the awesome nature!

Will only take about max 3 hours to finish. The highlight was the glass bridge and if you're lucky, watching someone bungee jump of the glass bridge. The Zipline was underwhelming, the slides were quite fun actually. Peaceful walk along the river to the exit.

I was there on the on 6th September 2025 with my family. It was spectacular crossing the Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge overlooking the mountains sceneries. It was such a great experience crossing over. A wonderful experience indeed !!
Super nice place. Stunning views and trip to remember forever. We did not have time to take a boat, but that would also be nice experience!

Am loving this place. Really have a great view of the canyon below and surrounding. For those who have the courage and strength, can go on the flying fox as the journey back up is really something to do for hiking. Half of the journey is downhill with plenty staircase but going up is easy using elevator and a bit of walking uphill

Glass view bridge is a nice thing to do. There are some extras to do that make the real fun. Zip line was funny thing to do. Not as scary as it looks. Slides were also fun. Boat is just a short trip up and down a small lake. A bit dull. Note that there is no exit, when you are at the lake, you have to go up again by climbing stairs, taking all the lifts up, climbing more stairs and then go over the glass bridge again. Luckily not so crowded today.

The bridge, with its stunning architecture, connects two mountains and is renowned as the longest and highest glass floor bridge. Walking across it leads to a building with a VR theater that simulates the experience of gliding in a balloon. While the VR theater was just satisfactory for me, there is a boat ride at the bottom that offers a delightful river view.

This glass-bottom bridge spans a canyon 300 meters above ground, offering incredible views of cliffs and forest. While structurally safe, it can cause vertigo and anxiety. Tourists should avoid leaning over edges, wear comfortable non-slip shoes, and avoid visiting during high winds or heavy rain. Mindful pacing and adhering to crowd limits ensure a safe and enjoyable experience.

The glass bridge is really huge and safe! The views are amazing and there are a lot of other activities available. For example, bungy jump and zipline! At the end of the trip, there is about a 4km walk of which it cannot skipped. If you think you will get tired because of the 4km walk, you can pay extra for your elevators/ zipline/ slides at the beginning of the trip so you can save more energy for the end of the trip! I do recommend this place! I have spent 4 hours for the whole trip (:
Had a lot of fun in that place! Amazing views! If you do not mind to walk on glass bridge and look down, higly recommended!
Not scary, over hype, but there are other attraction like flying fox and bungy jump, definitely better.

It was a great experience walking on the glass bridge. It would have been much scarier if was crystal clear. The day we were there was a bit misty and hence it was not crystal clear looking down. The view from the bridge was beautiful. To get down the canyon, you could get the 'experience package' that includes the lift, zip line, and the slide down the canyon after the bridge walk. We chose the option of just the ticket for the lift down for just one steep section. From there, we walk all the way to the other side of the canyon. It was a surprising almost 6km walk. Along the way, we passed by beautiful streams, a waterfall and a cave. I recommend to walk partially if you are physically fit and is there to enjoy the scenery.

Excellent. Longest glass bridge in the world. You have to come here. The entry ticket include glass bridge, VR, zipline, slide, boat on the valley and 3 times lift up. The ticket not include bungy jumping & rock climbing. Enjoy very much the VR and zipline (flying fox accross the canyon)
This place is nice but it's really depending on the weather. If it's raining or foggy, you can't see far

It was a memorable experience, not only the bridge, but the whole park, including the cable car ride to the bridge, the zipline ride back down, the huge elevators and the lake. A must-visit place when visiting China

Look… If you’re in Zhangjiajie, you have to come here. It’s one of the main things people see when they come here. The bridge is impressive and a cool novelty. The scenery is pretty. It’s super touristy and a bit… artificial?? I can’t quite find the word… It’s cool in general though. Great facilities with clean toilets. Recommend.

The name of this bridge being Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge is more popular than the name of this place itself - Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon. This bridge is truly an engineering marvel by the Chinese government to showcase that China can build quality products. It's really a deep canyon, and for the brave hearts - you can go for the zip line (just a baby chair like secured seat) with both feet dangling zipping over the deep canyon. It's really adrenalin pumping activity. There is also the Virtual Reality ride that takes you through an aerial view of the whole canyon and whatever its spectacular scenic area has to offer. As for walking on the glass bridge, it's not as bad as how was portrayed by the netizens. It's an ok walk to the other side of the canyon.

Pretty good place to visit. Tour runs straight through and ends with an enjoyable canyon hike on manufactured trails. Would recommend getting the 3 elevator passes down. The extra boat tour is nothing special.

Amazing scenery to watch. Keep in mind the main ticket doesn't include the options: lift, bunggie jumping, sliders neither zipline. They all can be purchased separately. The exit is about 3km walk. Great experience, not recommended if you are afraid of high or have a poor health condition.
Worth the experience and require climbing stairs and walks. Avoid the golden week. Lots of visits. Go with a guide

What a beautiful view of nature! Walking on the glass bridge is not as scary as I thought as the glass floor is quite foggy. Love the overall experience of walking in nature! We took a short boat ride as well. Do try the flying fox experience if you are a dare devil 😆
Did the attractions in the park, everything pales in comparison to the bungee jump. It's quite expensive, but worth it. It is the longest bungee jump in the world after all 🤩
Zhangjiajie glass bridge and surroundings are nature's classical art. A must to visit place

The Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge, located in China, is an extraordinary engineering marvel and a popular tourist destination. As the longest and tallest glass bridge in the world, it offers breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains and valleys, blending harmoniously into the picturesque landscape. Visitors first encounter the stunning structure suspended high above a 1,500-foot deep chasm, with a glass floor that provides a thrilling perspective of the valley below. For those seeking adventure, the bridge offers activities such as bungee jumping, ziplining, and cliff walking. Additionally, more leisurely options like a mountain lift, a serene lake, and a boat ride are available, ensuring a variety of experiences for everyone. The bridge also features opaque sections, accommodating those who may be uncomfortable with heights while still allowing them to appreciate the incredible scenery. Throughout the visit, the carefully designed viewpoints and hiking trails enhance the experience, making it accessible and enjoyable for people.
Got to experience route B. 1. Grand canyon glass bridge, 2. vr viewer was beautiful 3. Sky sliding 4. Boat ride 5. Scenic views

5/5 Stars "I recently had the privilege of visiting the Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge in China, and I must say, it's a technological marvel! The Chinese engineers have outdone themselves by creating this incredible structure that offers breathtaking views and thrilling experiences. The location itself is stunning, with the bridge suspended high above the valley, offering a heart-stopping view of the 1,500-foot deep chasm below. The feeling of standing on the glass floor, looking down at the valley below, is simply exhilarating! But that's not all - the Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge offers a range of activities for adventure-seekers, including bungee jumping, ziplining, and cliff walking. For those who prefer more leisurely activities, there's an open mountain lift, a small lake, and a boat ride available. What's truly remarkable about this attraction is that it makes these breathtaking views and experiences accessible to everyone, regardless of their mountaineering or rock climbing skills. The bridge, watching platforms, and scenic sites are all designed to provide a safe and enjoyable experience for visitors. Overall, the Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge is an absolute must-visit destination for anyone traveling to China. It's a testament to Chinese engineering and innovation, and an unforgettable experience that will leave you in awe. Rating Breakdown: - Technological Marvel: 5/5 - Scenic Beauty: 5/5 - Adventure Activities: 5/5 - Accessibility: 5/5 - Overall Experience: 5/5 Recommendation: Don't miss this incredible attraction! Plan your visit to Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge and experience the thrill of walking on glass above a stunning valley."

I would say this is not as scary as I thought. Beautiful sight to take some nice canyon pictures. Glass should have cleaned it so can see clearly the canyon view. However, a beautiful man made architectural and if you have height phobia , this would a challenge. Have fun!
This place is just more thn words. It's amazing It's beautiful Amazing views .. amaIzng activities. But better do not go in summer You should go in winter You can spend full day there.
Lots of walking, should try the zip line is not scary. But the slide is a bit rough no cushion.

Remember to take the discounted ticket but remember that if you weigh even a gram more than 90 kg, no one will allow you to perform Bunjee / Zip Line / Mountain Side walk. In the Package ticket price you can perform 5 activities out of 7. choose wisely. bungee n some other things at extra cost. Jhangjiajie train station to the location is 60 yuan per person for shared cab or 28 yuan for public transport bus.

They will provide a shoe cover for every guest enter. Spent bout 30 minutes on the bridge to take pictures of the surroundings, and with my tour group, it was super hot that day. All of the pictures look good. Reminder to bring sunglasses. They are a few forbidden items to enter the glass bridge like thermos flask, hiking stick, lighter, etc.

What an exciting place to be! Beautiful surrounding and walking on glass can be scary but exciting. Very well managed and organized. Try to come during low season and earlier in the day to avoid crowd.
View the beautiful landscape from a sunset. The cool weather and nice views will make you want to stay longer to take in the scene. slowly will edge into your memories.

Highlights were the zip lining, VR experience and the amazing views! The glass bridge was so cool but the glass wasn’t too transparent. The slide had potential but I recommend shoes off as my shoes added friction making it hard for me and others to slide down. Not too crowded.

Spectacular mountains which Avatar movie has been filmed in. 2. If you want check your courage to walk on a glass bridge over a haule of 260m come here. 3. Walking across the Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge was an experience like no other. As I stepped onto the transparent surface, a mix of excitement and nervousness washed over me. The bridge stretched out before me, a seemingly endless path suspended high above the canyon. The views were absolutely breathtaking - towering cliffs, lush greenery, and a winding river snaked through the valley below. It was like floating on air! While it might not be for everyone, the thrill of standing on a glass bridge hundreds of meters above the ground is an unforgettable adventure.

For a person who is afraid of height dont worry you can enjoy scenery drinking coffee without crossing the bridge 😅 although the construction is very solid, below the bridge actually there are a boat service that you can enjoy its looks looks like grand canyon of china

For our 14 days trip to Zhangjiajie and Chongqing, Gu Minghui was our tour leader. Having previously travelled with him, we chose him again due to his proven reliability. Throughout the trip, he prioritised everyone's well-being and safety. He was attentive to the dietary requirements of our group's vegetarians, ensuring strict adherence to our allium-free meals. Demonstrating his commitment, Minghui constantly provided weather forecasts for the following day. This thoughtful gesture allowed us to dress appropriately, safeguarding against potential illnesses caused by unexpected weather conditions. We look forward to joining other tours to be led by Minghui again.

GB experience was exceptional due to many other attractions in one place but some are optional to avail, It's a must go place for every visitor in Zhenjiajie due its beautiful canyon view between two mountain cliffs, Waterways, adventures walking trails and rides like Zip line, Slide ride, Highest elevator, Boat ride, bungee jumping Options to return from the the main attraction glass bridge 1) From glass Bridge it self - normal transport 2) Using the elevator down, then boat rides and walking for roughly 2 hours or less 3) Zip line - (Allowed weight is only 80kg), followed with slide ride, and taking steps down, then walking all the way to the exit 2 to 3 hours 4) Walking down by steps for 1 to 2 hrs then walk again to the exit which may take around 2 to 3 hours, plz exercise caution every where due to steep steps, slippery conditions in rain or snow or other wise, I missed a falling rock from above that was a new one. Although I had booked the vip tour, I followed the steps and walked all the way to the exit, and I did not regret even a bit as the trails were too good to be missed I did not qualify for the Zip line due to the weight limit >80kg We managed tour without a guide here and covered the place in 5 hours' time with loads of breaks Total steps 13k, total km walked 9.3, clean washrooms and food stalls available at various locations

very pretty views, everything is pretty mild tho. if your seeking some thrill, the bridge and the zip line are pretty tame. the slide was the funnest thing (if u dont get any ppl in front). but everythung is very pretty for taking pictures :)

Not all that much compared to the hype. But does have a very good views. But the glass bridge itself is not of as much worth.

Great views of the surrounding mountains from the bridge. The experience of standing on the glass bridge and looking through hundreds of metres down at the canyon is exhilarating. One of the most beautiful places I have visited.

Wanted to give more than 5 stars what a wonderful view through walking on longest glass bridge in the world where nature all around is amazing was a bit scary but used to it very fast and enjoyed so much I highly recommend to visit when you are in zhangjiajie city

【張家界大峽谷】 (雲天渡玻璃橋+VR 體驗) 【雲天渡玻璃橋】 位於張家界市慈利縣三官寺鄉，緊鄰世界自然遺產、世界地質公園張家界武陵源風景名勝區。 張家界大峽谷原來有兩個名字，一個叫做「爛船峽」，源於「神泉溪」，整個大峽谷和南方紅旗渠的水流都源自於此，傳說以前從泉眼中湧出過很多爛了的船板，當地人們又無法知曉爛船板從何而來，所以這裡得名「爛船峽」。另外一個名字叫做「亂泉峽」，是指峽谷中的兩面石壁，溪泉眾多，滿峽飛流。張家界大峽谷玻璃橋建設歷時 4 年多，號稱創下 10 項世界之最，包括：最高且最長的玻璃人行橋、橋面上建有世界最高彈跳臺、玻璃承重最重的橋樑、舒適性最好的橋樑等等。玻璃橋橋面距谷底高度約 300 公尺，走在橋上就好像行在空中

Walking across here feels like stepping into the void: a 430-meter-long glass bridge stretches above a canyon more than 300 meters deep. Every step reveals the breathtaking mountain scenery under your feet through the transparent glass. It’s both terrifying and exhilarating, rewarding your courage with unforgettable views. Entry requires a timed ticket, because after an earlier overcrowding the number of visitors is strictly regulated. Near the bridge, a glass slide and a zipline add to the adrenaline rush. Go on a clear day—the fog hides the spectacle. For photography, use an ultra-wide lens to capture the dizzying depth and the vast panorama. Magyar utasoknak: Átkelni itt olyan, mintha a semmibe lépnél: egy 430 méter hosszú üveghíd feszül a több mint 300 méter mély kanyon felett. Minden lépésnél a lábad alatt tárul fel az átlátszó üvegen keresztül a lenyűgöző hegyvidéki panoráma. Egyszerre félelmetes és felemelő élmény, ahol a bátorságot a szépség jutalmazza. A belépés időzített jeggyel történik, mivel egy korábbi túlterhelés után szigorúan szabályozzák a látogatók számát. A híd közelében üvegcsúszda és drótkötélpálya fokozza az adrenalinélményt. Érdemes tiszta időben menni, mert a köd elrejti a látványt. Fotózáshoz ultranagy látószögű objektív ajánlott, hogy érzékeltesd a mélységet és a távlatokat.

Mengunjungi Jembatan Kaca Zhangjiajie adalah salah satu pengalaman paling menakjubkan dan mendebarkan yang pernah saya alami. Jembatan ini menawarkan pemandangan yang luar biasa indah, dengan panorama pegunungan dan jurang yang memukau di sekitarnya. Kualitas konstruksi jembatan ini sangat mengesankan; meskipun terbuat dari kaca, saya merasa sangat aman dan nyaman berjalan di atasnya. Transparansi jembatan memberikan sensasi luar biasa, seolah-olah kita sedang melayang di udara. Staf di lokasi sangat profesional, ramah, dan siap membantu setiap saat, memastikan pengalaman setiap pengunjung berjalan lancar. Kebersihan dan perawatan area ini juga sangat terjaga, menambah kenyamanan saat berkunjung. Saya sangat merekomendasikan Jembatan Kaca Zhangjiajie kepada siapa saja yang berkunjung ke daerah ini. Ini adalah destinasi yang tidak boleh dilewatkan, dan saya berani mengatakan bahwa ini adalah salah satu atraksi wisata terbaik di dunia. 5 bintang tanpa ragu!
